_comment: Public download channels for the CoreTend website resolver (api/download.js). 'stable' mirrors Configuration/published-release.json. 'beta' points to the most recent published 1.1.0-beta.N prerelease on GitHub; /download?channel=beta resolves to it, while /download and /download?channel=stable stay on stable. When 'beta' is null the beta channel falls back to stable. Do NOT invent a beta artifact URL before the artifact exists on GitHub.
